project.title: Pyrosequencing analysis of 16S rRNA gene in laboratory-scale continuously stirred tank reactors
project.description: The goal of this study was to investigate the responses by bacterial and archaeal communities to straw and manure addition during anaerobic digestion at different temperatures.
